conversation_reference.reference: GPT conversation in which Zachary asked for the opt-out terms to be re-checked (reference carried as data; it grants no access)

known_choices.name: document_section
known_choices.source: Zachary pasted these terms to Muse on 2026-10-07

known_choices.name: report_verbatim
known_choices.value: true — quote the operative opt-out sentence exactly, do not paraphrase the destination

objective: Read Meta Muse's published Supplemental Terms and report, verbatim, what opt-out method Section 19 specifies: postal address or email, the exact destination, and the deadline window. Read-only; do not submit anything.

permissions.notes: Pure read of a public page. No sign-in, no payment, no send.

stop_conditions: If Muse.ai/terms does not resolve to Meta Platforms, Inc.'s Muse terms, stop and report the mismatch instead of reading further.
If the page requires sign-in to read the terms, stop and report that — do not sign in for a read-only check.
success_criteria: Result package quotes the opt-out sentence verbatim from the terms page, names the specified method and destination, and gives the terms page URL as evidence with basis page_text_fetch.
